verdict.rationale: The USCIS Torch developer platform documents a sandbox stage for its APIs. Developers register for an account, join a team, "develop in our Sandbox environment to send test data," then pass a demo before receiving production keys. That covers exercising the Case Status and FOIA rails before production. The sandbox documentation is thin, though: one-line mentions with no detail on what the sandbox covers or how closely it mirrors production. Missing for 10: detailed sandbox docs (test data sets, endpoint parity, limits), confirmation that both APIs are fully testable end to end in the sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration.
